content:
This week, in addition to releasing the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo, Apple also launched a brand new iPhone wrist strap accessory. Here are the relevant details.

Apple's new wrist strap accessory can be used with the iPhone case and AirPods Pro

Apple continues to expand its iPhone accessory product line, launching several new products.

In addition to a series of new cases designed for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo, Apple also simultaneously launched a brand new wrist strap accessory.

This wrist strap is designed to be attached to designated Apple iPhone cases and AirPods Pro, making it convenient for users to carry their products hands-free. The strap is carefully woven from 100% recycled PET yarn and remains comfortable to wear on the wrist all day long. The built-in flexible magnets keep the strap tidy and neatly in place.

The wrist strap is 15.4 inches in total length and is compatible with most official iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max cases, as well as the iPhone 17 series.

Available colors include wine red, bright blue, olive green, taupe, magenta, and black.

This strap can be considered a fairly simple and straightforward new addition to Apple's accessory lineup. Equipped with the new wrist strap, your iPhone and/or AirPods Pro can hang securely on your wrist, providing better protection.

You can order the Apple wrist strap for $29 through the Amazon link below.

Third-party accessory manufacturers have been offering similar products for years, but it is indeed exciting to finally see Apple's official version arrive.

Would you order a wrist strap for your iPhone or AirPods? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
